title: clearance's proofs reach the system temp directory only through the scratch door
intention: Every proof in cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance takes its temp directory from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.scratch_dir, so nothing a clearance proof makes outlives its run, and clearance proves that of its own proofs.
why: Measured 2026-11-23 on akiendelllinux: bare_temp_reach over the repo named cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/proofs/test_the_gated_crossing_tooth_crosses_in_its_fixture_world.py:63 (tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="gated-world-")), landed under 9996bf7186e3 (01c0aa0a8, 2026-11-19), so cairn/tools/scratch/proofs/test_scratch.py::test_no_proof_in_this_repo_calls_mkdtemp_bare and test_scratch_is_a_tool.py read red (red tickets 0746da231128, a30a49e8631f).
traces_to: Law 4 (the scratch door is physics, and this line steps around it) and CP6 (what a proof leaves in /tmp accumulates unseen; 3581 dirs did once).
how: In cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/proofs/test_the_gated_crossing_tooth_crosses_in_its_fixture_world.py:63: tmp = str(scratch_dir("gated-world-")), scratch_dir imported from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch after the sys.path insert, and tempfile leaves the imports. the red-first proof cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/proofs/test_clearances_proofs_reach_temp_only_through_the_scratch_door.py, PROVES 0d98f7325181 key '1' on one tooth test_no_proof_in_clearance_reaches_temp_bare, calls cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.bare_temp_reach over cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance and asserts it names nothing, in the shape of cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_base_proofs_reach_temp_only_through_the_scratch_door.py. Proofs-only build. Prepared on akienasus/mkdtemp-scratch-door.

clauses.claim: bare_temp_reach over cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance names no line, so no clearance proof reaches the system temp directory except through scratch_dir

decisions.text: D1: cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/proofs/test_the_gated_crossing_tooth_crosses_in_its_fixture_world.py:63: tmp = str(scratch_dir("gated-world-")), scratch_dir imported from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch after the sys.path insert, and tempfile leaves the imports. Every tooth keeps its assertion.

D2: the red-first proof cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance/proofs/test_clearances_proofs_reach_temp_only_through_the_scratch_door.py, PROVES 0d98f7325181 key '1' on one tooth test_no_proof_in_clearance_reaches_temp_bare, calls cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.bare_temp_reach over cairn/devices/codemother/machines/clearance and asserts it names nothing, in the shape of cairn/tools/base/proofs/test_base_proofs_reach_temp_only_through_the_scratch_door.py.

out: every other component's bare sites (each in its own ticket, RULE 1)
cairn/tools/scratch (the door and the scan are unchanged)
